title: Architect Review Route and Repair Work Card Association
problem: WC08-REPAIR04 validation is blocked because the app identifies the current action as Architect review of a repair Implementer Report, but routes the workspace to Implementer Report Capture with no usable repair Work Card association and visible skipped-file schema warnings.
goal: Route Architect review of repair Implementer Reports to an Architect review-capable workflow, auto-bind the current repair target and Implementer Report, and prevent historical invalid JSON warnings from blocking or dominating the routed current-action UI.
userOutcome: The Operator can validate WC08-REPAIR04 through the application because the routed workspace matches the Architect review obligation and is pre-bound to WC08-REPAIR04 evidence.
scope: Correct route-to-workspace mapping for architect_review_of_implementer_report_required repair targets.
Auto-bind WC08-REPAIR04 and its Implementer Report from current-action state.
Support repair Work Card schemas in Work Card association lists.
Downgrade or hide historical/superseded invalid JSON warnings in the routed workflow.
Preserve WC08-REPAIR04 route authority and route review behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: App opens to WC08-REPAIR04 or the actual current WC08 repair-chain obligation, not stale WC01 or WC09.
The routed workspace title and form behavior match Architect review of repair Implementer Report required.
The routed workspace does not show Implementer Report Capture as the primary task when the current action is Architect review.
The routed workspace auto-binds to WC08-REPAIR04 from current-action state.
The associated WC08-REPAIR04 Implementer Report is selected or displayed without requiring manual Work Card selection.
Repair Work Cards appear in association lists when a manual fallback selector is used.
Historical/superseded invalid JSON warnings do not block or dominate the current routed workflow.
The Operator can proceed to Architect review output creation or preview from the routed workspace.
WC08-REPAIR04 route review request behavior remains available and governed.
WC08-REPAIR02 and WC08-REPAIR03 behavior remains intact.
WC09 remains blocked until WC08 repair-chain obligations are resolved.
Focused fixture coverage exists for repair Architect Review route binding and repair Work Card association.
validationPlan: Run TypeScript/type validation and production build validation.
Add focused fixture coverage for Architect review route binding for repair Implementer Reports.
Add focused fixture coverage for WC08-REPAIR04 auto-binding and repair Work Card association parsing.
Run preservation fixtures for WC08-REPAIR01, WC08-REPAIR02, WC08-REPAIR03, and WC04-WC07 if affected.
